metric_definitions.recall_stage_local: positive source time passed by the stage / positive source time the stage received
metric_definitions.recall_cumulative: positive source time passed by the stage / positive source time in the ORIGINAL source
metric_definitions.precision: positive source time passed / total time passed
metric_definitions.drop_rate: units lost WITHOUT a receipt / units received (deliberate suppression is not a drop)

Without a time-resolved admission series there is nothing to intersect with audio ground truth, so audio Stage-1 recall and precision are NOT instrumentable through the public API.

reconciliation.note: A failing check here is a BOOKKEEPING defect in the runtime's own mirror, not necessarily a data-path defect: the per-stage metrics in this report are derived from the trace stream and the `source_coverage` ledger, both of which reconcile.

analysis.power_note: Per-cell ground-truth event counts at Stage 1: `duration` n=6. A 0.95 recall bar is NOT statistically ratifiable on this corpus at any configuration: an exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bound clearing 0.95 with ZERO misses needs n=59 positives — even a flawless 6-event `duration` cell bounds only at 0.607. Measured exact lower bounds on Stage-1 event recall: `duration` 0.667 (95% lower 0.271, n=6). `state` (n=0 events over 0 cases) is reported and NEVER gated — it cannot support a claim at any confidence.
analysis.loss_narrative: Lossless on positive time at this boundary: Stage 0 - Ingest + normalize; Stage 2 - Local perception; Stage 3 - Judge dispatch.

not_instrumented.boundary: Audio / VAD admission recall and precision (Stage 1, acoustic)
not_instrumented.why: The runtime emits NO per-audio-chunk admission event. `edge.decision` is the VIDEO gate only; an acoustic wake surfaces solely as the aggregate counters `RuntimeStats.audio_wakes` and `admission_by_cause['audio']`. With no time-resolved admission series there is nothing to intersect with audio ground truth, so audio Stage-1 recall/precision cannot be computed from the public API. Separately, the audio-ONLY entrypoint (`run(source=None, audio_source=...)`) refuses an ordinary `Goal` — it requires a compiled Watch — so audio had to be measured on the fused path. A COMPONENT-level `AcousticOnset` recall is reported instead, clearly labelled as not-the-public-path.

not_instrumented.boundary: Stage 2 as a measuring point (local perception)
not_instrumented.why: With no `EvidenceExtractor` armed, Stage 2 is an identity pass-through: it emits one `source.frame` per admitted unit and `perceive_dispatches == escalations` exactly. Its economy of 1.000 therefore cannot distinguish 'lossless' from 'absent'. The senses (`rhythm`, `identity`, `entity`, `sequencing`) are independent modules with no shared metrics contract, so there is no per-sense precision/recall to read.

not_instrumented.boundary: Physical provider attempts and typed terminal receipts (Stage 3)
not_instrumented.why: `run()` exposes no route/receipt surface. `JudgeRouteReceipt` outcomes (`deadline`, `capacity`, `no_route`, `cancelled`) exist only on a `JudgePool` the caller constructs and holds. Physical attempts here are counted at the ADAPTER boundary (the scripted judge's own call counter), which equals logical calls because a direct adapter does not hedge. Route-level hedging is unmeasured by this harness.

Accepted by `run()` and SILENTLY IGNORED on the video path: it is forwarded only to `_run_audio_only`, so the video `_JudgeScheduler` never receives it. Queue depth and oldest-pending-age for video are therefore unobservable through the documented mechanism. This harness reconciles against `RuntimeStats` and the `on_health` `runtime_ended.source_coverage` ledger instead.

not_instrumented.boundary: Units offered UPSTREAM of the decoder
not_instrumented.why: Stage 0's denominator here is frames the decoder actually yielded. Frames lost inside the container/codec before `cap.read()` returns them are invisible to any counter in the runtime, so ingest recall is measured against what the decoder delivered, not against what the file nominally contains.

`RuntimeStats.judge_calls` counts scheduler BATCH launches while `perceive_dispatches` counts per-job launches; they are different units and must not be divided by each other. Both are reported separately rather than combined into one economy figure.

method_checks: Runtime under test verified at import: `build_info().git_commit == 083b972c75b012df32d811f93d39b6bc25406999`.
Zero provider or network calls: the only judge is a scripted in-process object keyed on a payload hash.
Stage-1 substitution VERIFIED per case, not assumed: the FILE arm and the ORACLE arm must admit the identical set of timestamps. Held on 6 of 6 cases where it was checkable.

Salience reproduction VERIFIED per case against the wheel's own `salience_stats`: `trace.motion == mean` and `escalate == (block_max >= 0.2)` held exactly on 6 of 6 cases; only those contribute to the threshold sweep.
Aggregates pool numerators and denominators over time and units. Per-case means are reported alongside so a pooled figure driven by one long clip is visible.
Suppression is never counted as a drop: a tier-0 rejection emits its own `edge.decision` record naming the signal and the threshold it failed, which is the receipt.
Economy floor cross-checked against the value pinned in the runtime (`percept/slo.py` `FOVEA_CALL_REDUCTION_FLOOR = 0.5`).
omnipro ground truth is zero-width instants; widened by a declared 1.0 s tolerance and tagged `gt_kind=instant` so it never enters an interval bar unannounced.
